record.question: Which organ is responsible for majority of drug excretion?
record.explanation: Answer D: Kidney. The kidneys excrete most drugs or their metabolites through urine, though some drugs also use biliary or other routes. Source/context note: Drug elimination is drug-specific; some compounds are primarily hepatobiliary or pulmonary. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557744/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
